construction.implementation_origin: Original implementation authored in the isolated build directory.

input.synthetic: true; all data must be explicitly synthetic
input.sources: array of unique id, title, text
input.products: array of unique id, name, source_ids, attributes
input.preferences: nonempty unique attribute selections from price_usd, weight_g, battery_hours, each with direction min|max and positive finite weight
input.feedback: array of unique id, product_id, text; references must exist

output.success: schema_version:1, status:ok, synthetic:true, research, comparison, feedback
output.research: findings with extractive text, matched_terms and source_id/title/start/end/quote citation; supported product_ids
output.comparison: canonical columns, side-by-side rows with finding_ids, ranking with rank, product_id, score, utilities
output.feedback: selected_product_ids in ranking order, unique_feedback_count, duplicate_count, themes with counts and exact supporting excerpts

shared_schema.validation: One validate() dispatch layer checks input types, references, finite values, units, exact citations and cross-stage consistency. Every stage validates incoming and outgoing handoffs. JSON duplicate keys and nonfinite constants are rejected.

cross_stage_handoffs.data: Validated findings and supported product_ids determine eligible comparison rows; rows retain finding_ids pointing to exact source citations.
Validated ranking restricts feedback to compared products; excerpts retain comparison_rank, product_id, exact feedback text, original feedback_id and duplicate_ids.

behavior.research: Sentence passages split on .!? and newlines; Unicode word-token query overlap ignoring a small explicit English stopword set; order by descending matched-term count, source id, then offset. Offsets are zero-based half-open Unicode character indices.
behavior.normalization: USD retained; kg multiplied by 1000 for grams; minutes divided by 60 for hours. Unsupported units/currency fail validation; omitted attributes remain null.
behavior.ranking: Weighted min-max utility among research-supported products. Preferred direction sets utility orientation. Missing values score zero; tied present values score one. Weights are scaled to avoid overflow; scores rounded to eight decimals; ties resolved by product id.
behavior.deduplication: Per-product case-folded Unicode word-token sequence ignores punctuation and whitespace. Representative is the lexicographically smallest feedback id; all other original ids remain traceable.
behavior.themes: Deterministic explicit keyword vocabularies for battery, price, weight, usability, reliability; unmatched feedback falls under other. One unique item may support multiple themes, so theme counts are not additive.
behavior.empty_matches: Returns successful empty research, comparison and feedback collections.
behavior.synthetic_fixture: All products, sources and feedback in example_input.json are invented.
behavior.prompt_logging: An ancillary docs\My_prompt.txt records the supplied prompts; the four requested deliverables are listed above.

included: Exact source citations and feedback provenance
Canonical units, preference ranking and missing-value handling
Shared validation, CLI JSON errors and standard-library unit tests
excluded: Live search, networks, external model providers and LLM generation
Independent verification or extraction of product attributes from prose
Semantic retrieval, paraphrase deduplication, sentiment inference
Currency conversion, enterprise deployment and persistence services

coverage: Unit normalization, ranked preferences, ties and missing attributes
Research eligibility and preference propagation into feedback
Invalid input types, units, currency, numbers and references
CLI success, usage, file, JSON and schema errors
